alerts.headline: ChatGPT官方Word插件(9/17)以持久化侧边栏嵌入Microsoft Word原生编辑界面，可直接选中文档内文本下达编辑指令，比上一轮'常驻打开供分析'更进一步逼近跨工具live嵌入
alerts.evidence: 「The ChatGPT add-in...adds the AI assistant to Word through a persistent sidebar...For a specific edit, select the text in Word and describe what you want changed.」
alerts.action_suggestion: 建议下轮核实该侧边栏是否支持多人协作可见性与真正的双向live同步(而非仅单用户会话内的常驻)，评估其对meee2锚点2(live link非snapshot)差异化优势的收窄程度。

alerts.headline: GitHub Copilot新增Sentry canvas集成，与上一轮Jira canvas共同构成'外部工具artifact→canvas→人筛选→AI贯穿排查/修复/PR'的可复用产品模式，正在被productize而非一次性功能
alerts.evidence: 「Move from crash report to code fix with the new Sentry canvas in the GitHub Copilot app. Review errors, stack traces, and related context, then work with Copilot to investigate the cause, validate a fix, and prepare a pull request.」
alerts.action_suggestion: 建议评估Copilot这一可复用canvas模式与meee2菜单栏跨工具pull(F9)的能力差异，特别是live同步 vs. 一次性快照的机制细节，作为差异化沟通素材并持续跟踪该模式接入的下一个外部工具。

alerts.headline: Gemini in Workspace新增通过MCP直连Asana/Atlassian Rovo/HubSpot/Mailchimp/QuickBooks/Monday/Salesforce七个第三方工具，可在Docs/Sheets/Slides侧边栏及Chat内直接访问，无需切标签/下载文件
alerts.evidence: 「access information directly without needing to switch tabs, download files, or interrupt workflows」
alerts.action_suggestion: 建议跟踪该MCP直连是只读查询还是可编辑、可持续live同步的双向artifact link，评估其对meee2锚点4(跨工具/跨owner artifact pull)差异化优势的收窄程度。

alerts.headline: Linear Loops扩展为响应workspace真实活动变化(项目/周期/计划变更)并跨系统(Linear文档+Slack)自动执行更新，是descriptive-first触发机制的一个具体产品化案例
alerts.evidence: 「Loops are recurring agent workflows for teams. They now respond to more workspace activity, including changes to initiatives, projects, and cycles. They can also edit Linear documents and post updates to Slack.」
alerts.action_suggestion: 建议将Loops'由真实workspace活动描述性触发'的机制与meee2锚点3(descriptive-first)做对比分析，评估其触发粒度与meee2的差距，作为产品叙事参考。

alerts.headline: Raycast v2.3将AI Chat核心重建为自主任务执行agent(自行拟定计划、调用extension、编写运行代码、持续推进直到完成)，peripheral层入口内部已具备完整'快session'执行能力
alerts.evidence: 「You can now give AI Chat a task and it works out a plan, uses your extensions, writes and runs code, checks the results, and keeps going until it's finished. When something fails, it tries a different approach.」
alerts.action_suggestion: 建议密切跟踪Raycast是否会在此基础上叠加session管理、多agent总览等能力，评估其对meee2菜单栏peripheral层(锚点5)定位的直接竞争风险，并作为差异化沟通的重点监控对象。
